style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website for elementary students in Taiwan. Landscape 3:2. Characters: Taiwanese (East Asian) children and adults drawn in a gentle Japanese anime picture-book style, natural expressions, age-appropriate child proportions (elementary-school kids look 7-12 years old). Taiwanese school uniform = plain polo shirt or white shirt with shorts/skirt, or sports PE uniform; NO red neckerchief, NO red scarf. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, paper texture visible. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy brown, generous ivory breathing room; no bright flat digital colors, no glossy 3D, no imitation of a named artist. Every person has five fingers per hand, arms clearly attached to shoulders, feet grounded and pointing naturally. scene_prompt: 一毛不拔 means extreme stinginess, refusing even the tiniest contribution despite having plenty. At a modern neighborhood charity table, two ordinary adults each happily put a single plain coin into a transparent donation jar with no label. A third adult stands prominently in foreground clutching a very full open brown wallet TIGHTLY against his chest with both hands, shielding every coin and turning away with a stubborn miserly expression. He clearly has ample money and refuses to share even one small coin. Nearby table has neatly packed food parcels for people in need. No readable banknotes, currencies, brand marks or text. Gently humorous, do not portray poverty as the reason for refusal.
